Gold Rate in Sargodha: 24K, 22K, 21K and 18K

Gold purity changes the price because karat measures the proportion of gold in the alloy. 24K is the highest-purity category shown here, while 22K, 21K and 18K contain a greater proportion of other metals. When comparing today gold rate Sargodha across jewellers, make sure you are comparing the same karat and the same unit.

What Is the Gold Rate per Tola in Sargodha?

In Pakistan, gold is commonly quoted by tola. One tola is approximately 11.664 grams. That means the per-gram rate can be estimated by dividing the per-tola benchmark by 11.664. For example, Rs 455,000 ÷ 11.664 gives approximately Rs 39,010 per gram for 24K gold.

Why Gold Rates Change in Sargodha

The number on a gold-rate board is influenced by more than the jewellery shop itself. International gold prices, the Pakistani rupee against the US dollar, local bullion-market conditions, demand, supply, market sentiment and the timing of the quote can all affect the benchmark used by buyers and sellers.

For a jewellery customer, the final price can move again after the benchmark is known. The amount of gold in the item, karat, design complexity, making or labour charges, stone work, wastage policy and any applicable taxes or service charges all matter. This is why the gold rate today in Sargodha should be treated as the starting benchmark rather than the complete invoice amount.

How to Calculate Jewellery Price from Today's Gold Rate

A simple estimate starts with net gold weight × price per gram for the selected purity. Then the jeweller adds the applicable making or labour charges and any other agreed charges. For a fair comparison, ask for the bill to separate net gold weight, gold rate, making charges, stone charges and other applicable amounts.

Gold Buying Guide for Customers in Sargodha

  • Confirm the karat before comparing rates. A 24K figure should not be compared directly with a 22K jewellery quote.
  • Ask whether the displayed number is a buying rate, selling rate or general benchmark.
  • Check the net gold weight, especially when jewellery contains stones or non-gold components.
  • Request a clear breakdown of gold value, making/labour charges and other charges.
  • For investment or resale decisions, confirm the live market rate immediately before the transaction because gold prices can change during the day.

Gold Rate Today Sargodha FAQs

What is the gold rate today in Sargodha?

For 5 September 2026, a published Pakistan benchmark lists 24K gold at Rs 455,000 per tola. Local Sargodha buying and selling quotes can differ, so confirm the live rate before a transaction.

What is the 24K gold price per gram?

Using 1 tola ≈ 11.664 grams, Rs 455,000 per tola is approximately Rs 39,010 per gram.

Why does jewellery cost more than the gold rate?

The daily benchmark is only one part of a jewellery quote. Making or labour charges, stone work, wastage policy, net gold weight and other agreed charges can increase the final bill.

Does the gold rate stay the same all day?

No. Gold markets can move during the day. Online figures from different providers may also represent different update times, market locations or buy/sell sides.
